Movie, TV, anime and video game trivia for 2 to 4 teams, or up to 8 players each for themselves, around one screen: 1,108 questions across 22 fandoms, with phones as controllers.

**New in 1.9: Fandomonium for Mac**
- **Download `Fandomonium.dmg` below.** One download for every Mac, Apple silicon or Intel, running macOS 13 Ventura or later.
- Like the Windows app, it plays the latest version of the game from the website, so it updates itself, and it plays the built-in copy when you're offline.
- Command+Q quits, and Control+Command+F (or the Full screen button) goes full screen.

**Opening it on a Mac the first time**
1. Open `Fandomonium.dmg` and drag Fandomonium into Applications.
2. Open Fandomonium. The Mac says it can't verify the app, because it isn't notarized by Apple. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings**, go to **Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**, then confirm with your password.

After that it opens normally.

**On Windows**

Already have the app from 1.5 or later? It updates itself, so there's nothing to download. Otherwise, **download `Fandomonium.exe` below** and double-click it. Nothing to install.

- Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
- Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" because the app isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- F11 for full screen. Teams buzz with Q, P, Z and M. In the Final Gauntlet, use Q/W, O/P, Z/X and N/M.

Rather not download anything? [Play in your browser](https://matthewsleclair-hue.github.io/fandomonium/play/).
